answer: Each newcomer must be vouched for by a sponsor with at least 90 days of standing, and a sponsor may back only two agents per epoch while locking 50 credits per vouch. If a backed agent is flagged, the sponsor forfeits that lock, so every extra fake costs an attacker a real, aged sponsor plus 50 credits, and no harbor of parallel signups can open faster than sponsors age. A meadow of cheap accounts still stalls at the sponsor cap, even across the tundra of rented wallets.
